name: Reactome Content Service

provider.name: Reactome (OICR, EMBL-EBI, NYULH, Univ. of Toronto)

summary: Curated human biological pathways and reactions: pathway hierarchy, participants, cross-references and full-text search.
description: The Reactome Content Service serves pathway and reaction data (database objects by stable id, event hierarchies, participants, species, diseases), a search endpoint, mapping of identifiers to pathways and orthology. An OpenAPI 3 spec is published. A separate Analysis Service handles enrichment analysis.

rate_limit.summary: Not documented in the pages fetched; fair use.

endpoints.summary: Database object by stable id (R-HSA-xxxx) or dbId

license.name: Reactome content under CC BY 4.0 (illustrations and branding confirmed; data terms on the license page)

coverage.geographic: Global (human with orthology to other species)

agent_notes: Stable ids look like R-HSA-109581 (R-<species>-<number>). Search highlights matches with HTML span tags that you should strip. For gene-list enrichment use the separate Analysis Service at reactome.org/AnalysisService (not tested).
caveats: Search results wrap matched terms in HTML span tags.
Only the CC BY 4.0 statement for art and branding was read on the license page today; check it for data terms.
Release cadence ("quarterly") is an assumption, not confirmed.
